CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION platform_private.b2b_own_obligations(p_partner_id uuid, p_before timestamp with time zone, p_before_id uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO ''
AS $function$
DECLARE owner uuid; rows jsonb;
BEGIN
 owner:=platform_private.b2b_own_obligations_owner(p_partner_id);
 IF (p_before IS NULL) <> (p_before_id IS NULL) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'invalid_cursor' USING ERRCODE='22023'; END IF;
 SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(q.value ORDER BY q.created_at DESC,q.id DESC),'[]'::jsonb) INTO rows FROM (
 SELECT ar.id,ar.created_at,jsonb_build_object('id',ar.id,'order_id',po.id,'numero',po.numero,
 'created_at',ar.created_at,'total',ar.total_amount,'status',ar.status,
 'installments',COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id',i.id,'numero',i.installment_number,
 'vencimento',i.due_date,'valor',i.original_amount,'recebido',i.received_amount,'status',i.status)
 ORDER BY i.installment_number,i.id) FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=ar.id),'[]'::jsonb)) value
 FROM public.partner_orders po JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id=po.id
 JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id=l.receivable_id
 WHERE po.partner_id=p_partner_id AND l.partner_id=p_partner_id AND ar.partner_id=p_partner_id
 AND ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ar.origin_id=po.id AND ar.organization_id=owner
 -- A title with an ambiguous order/link or foreign/unowned installment is not projected.
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links x WHERE x.receivable_id=ar.id)=1
 AND (SELECT count(*) FROM public.partner_order_financial_links x WHERE x.partner_order_id=po.id)=1
 AND ar.total_amount>=0 AND ar.total_amount::text NOT IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
 AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=ar.id
  AND (i.organization_id IS DISTINCT FROM owner OR i.original_amount IS NULL OR i.received_amount IS NULL
   OR i.original_amount<0 OR i.received_amount<0 OR i.original_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')
   OR i.received_amount::text IN ('NaN','Infinity','-Infinity')))
 AND (p_before IS NULL OR (ar.created_at,ar.id)<(p_before,p_before_id))
 ORDER BY ar.created_at DESC,ar.id DESC LIMIT 50
 ) q;
 RETURN jsonb_build_object('contract','C2_OWN_OBLIGATIONS_V1','partner_id',p_partner_id,
 'rows',rows,'limit',50,'documents_enabled',false);
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_b2b_credit_exposure(p_partner_id uuid, p_new_order_amount numeric DEFAULT 0, p_exclude_order_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_limit numeric(14,2); v_open numeric(14,2); v_overdue numeric(14,2);
  v_committed numeric(14,2); v_pending numeric(14,2);
  v_new numeric(14,2) := ROUND(COALESCE(p_new_order_amount,0),2);
  v_proj numeric(14,2); v_disp numeric(14,2); v_pct numeric;
  v_tolerance int; v_block boolean; v_action text; v_reason text;
BEGIN
  SELECT COALESCE(credit_limit,0), COALESCE(overdue_tolerance_days,0),
         COALESCE(block_if_overdue,false), COALESCE(credit_limit_action,'block')
    INTO v_limit, v_tolerance, v_block, v_action
  FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = p_partner_id;
  v_limit := COALESCE(v_limit,0); v_tolerance := COALESCE(v_tolerance,0);
  v_block := COALESCE(v_block,false); v_action := COALESCE(v_action,'block');

  -- (a) recebiveis em aberto do parceiro
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_open
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE');

  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) INTO v_overdue
  FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
  WHERE ar.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    AND ari.due_date < (current_date - v_tolerance);

  -- (b) pedidos com compromisso financeiro real e SEM recebivel gerado
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_committed
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega',
                      'confirmado','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  -- (c) H4-001: pedidos vivos ainda nao aprovados ja consomem limite.
  --     Sem isso, N pedidos em analise passavam individualmente no teste
  --     de credito e estouravam o limite ao serem aprovados.
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ROUND(COALESCE(po.final_amount_with_interest, po.total, 0),2)),0)
    INTO v_pending
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  WHERE po.partner_id = p_partner_id
    AND po.status IN ('pendente','solicitado','em_analise_comercial',
                      'aguardando_aprovacao_credito','aguardando_ajuste_comercial',
                      'aguardando_itens')
    AND COALESCE(po.receivable_generated,false) = false
    AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.partner_order_financial_links pofl
                    WHERE pofl.partner_order_id = po.id)
    AND (p_exclude_order_id IS NULL OR po.id <> p_exclude_order_id);

  v_proj := ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending + v_new, 2);
  v_disp := GREATEST(v_limit - v_proj, 0);
  v_pct  := CASE WHEN v_limit > 0 THEN ROUND((v_proj / v_limit) * 100, 2) ELSE 0 END;

  v_reason := CASE
    WHEN v_block AND v_overdue > 0 THEN 'OVERDUE_BLOCK'
    WHEN v_limit <= 0 THEN 'NO_LIMIT_DEFINED'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit AND v_action = 'approval_required' THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_APPROVAL'
    WHEN v_proj > v_limit THEN 'LIMIT_EXCEEDED_BLOCK'
    ELSE 'OK' END;

  RETURN jsonb_build_object(
    'partner_id', p_partner_id,
    'credit_limit', v_limit,
    'saldo_em_aberto', v_open,
    'saldo_vencido', v_overdue,
    'comprometido_nao_faturado', v_committed,
    'comprometido_pendente', v_pending,
    'novo_pedido', v_new,
    'exposicao_atual', ROUND(v_open + v_committed + v_pending, 2),
    'exposicao_projetada', v_proj,
    'credito_disponivel', v_disp,
    'percentual_utilizado', v_pct,
    'overdue_tolerance_days', v_tolerance,
    'block_if_overdue', v_block,
    'credit_limit_action', v_action,
    'tem_vencidos', v_overdue > 0,
    'reason_code', v_reason
  );
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_aging(_type text DEFAULT 'RECEIVABLE'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket text, total numeric, qtd integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF _type = 'PAYABLE' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT CASE WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 0 THEN 'A vencer'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 30 THEN '1-30'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 90 THEN '61-90'
                ELSE '90+' END,
           SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))::numeric,
           COUNT(*)::int
    FROM accounts_payable_installments
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT CASE WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 0 THEN 'A vencer'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 30 THEN '1-30'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 60 THEN '31-60'
                WHEN (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - due_date <= 90 THEN '61-90'
                ELSE '90+' END,
           SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))::numeric,
           COUNT(*)::int
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments
    WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
    GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY 1;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_cashflow(_from date, _to date, _granularity text DEFAULT 'day'::text, _mode text DEFAULT 'projected'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(bucket date, entradas numeric, saidas numeric, saldo numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_trunc text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  v_trunc := CASE _granularity WHEN 'week' THEN 'week' WHEN 'month' THEN 'month' ELSE 'day' END;

  IF _mode = 'realized' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH ent AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, payment_date)::date AS b, SUM(amount_received) AS v
                 FROM receivable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1),
         sai AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, payment_date)::date AS b, SUM(amount_paid) AS v
                 FROM payable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1)
    SELECT COALESCE(e.b, s.b),
           COALESCE(e.v,0)::numeric,
           COALESCE(s.v,0)::numeric,
           (COALESCE(e.v,0) - COALESCE(s.v,0))::numeric
    FROM ent e FULL JOIN sai s ON s.b = e.b
    ORDER BY 1;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH ent AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, due_date)::date AS b,
                        SUM(GREATEST(0,original_amount + COALESCE(interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))) AS v
                 FROM accounts_receivable_installments
                 WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1),
         sai AS (SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, due_date)::date AS b,
                        SUM(GREATEST(0,original_amount + COALESCE(interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))) AS v
                 FROM accounts_payable_installments
                 WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to GROUP BY 1)
    SELECT COALESCE(e.b, s.b),
           COALESCE(e.v,0)::numeric,
           COALESCE(s.v,0)::numeric,
           (COALESCE(e.v,0) - COALESCE(s.v,0))::numeric
    FROM ent e FULL JOIN sai s ON s.b = e.b
    ORDER BY 1;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_dashboard_kpis(_from date, _to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'receitas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'receitas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_received) FROM receivable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'despesas_previstas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'despesas_realizadas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(amount_paid) FROM payable_payments WHERE payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to),0),
    'inadimplencia_total', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(received_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
    'pagar_vencidas', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(original_amount - COALESCE(paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(discount_amount,0))
        FROM accounts_payable_installments WHERE status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
    'entregas_nao_faturadas_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM entregas WHERE financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND receivable_id IS NULL),0),
    'entregas_nao_faturadas_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * p.valor_litro_brl) FROM entregas e
        LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id WHERE e.financial_status='PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL),0),
    'nfe_pendente_qtd', COALESCE((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0),
    'nfe_pendente_valor', COALESCE((SELECT SUM(total_amount) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE fiscal_invoice_required=true AND fiscal_invoice_status='PENDING'),0)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_dre_summary(_from date, _to date, _regime text DEFAULT 'COMPETENCIA'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(dre_group text, total numeric, qtd integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _regime = 'CAIXA' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH receitas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(rp.amount_received) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM receivable_payments rp
      JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
      WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      GROUP BY 1
    ),
    despesas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(pp.amount_paid) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM payable_payments pp
      JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
      JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
      WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      GROUP BY 1
    )
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM receitas
    UNION ALL
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM despesas;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    WITH receitas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(ari.original_amount) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
      WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
      GROUP BY 1
    ),
    despesas AS (
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group, 'NAO_CLASSIFICADO') AS g, SUM(api.original_amount) AS v, COUNT(*) AS q
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
      JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
      LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
      WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
      GROUP BY 1
    )
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM receitas
    UNION ALL
    SELECT g, v::numeric, q::int FROM despesas;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_inadimplencia()
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, receivable_id uuid, customer_id uuid, customer_name text, due_date date, amount numeric, dias_atraso integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT ari.id, ar.id, ar.customer_id, c.nome, ari.due_date,
         (ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))::numeric,
         ((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)::int
  FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
  JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
  WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
  ORDER BY ari.due_date ASC;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_revenue_by_category(_from date, _to date, _regime text DEFAULT 'COMPETENCIA'::text, _limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(category_id uuid, category_name text, dre_group text, total numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF _regime = 'CAIXA' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT fc.id, fc.name, fc.dre_group, SUM(rp.amount_received)::numeric
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
    JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
    WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
    GROUP BY fc.id, fc.name, fc.dre_group
    ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT _limit;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT fc.id, fc.name, fc.dre_group, SUM(ari.original_amount)::numeric
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
    JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
    WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
    GROUP BY fc.id, fc.name, fc.dre_group
    ORDER BY 4 DESC LIMIT _limit;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_fin_revenue_by_customer(_from date, _to date, _regime text DEFAULT 'COMPETENCIA'::text, _limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS TABLE(customer_id uuid, customer_name text, total numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF _regime = 'CAIXA' THEN
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT ar.customer_id, c.nome, SUM(rp.amount_received)::numeric
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
    JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
    WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
    GROUP BY ar.customer_id, c.nome
    ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT _limit;
  ELSE
    RETURN QUERY
    SELECT ar.customer_id, c.nome, SUM(ari.original_amount)::numeric
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
    JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
    WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
    GROUP BY ar.customer_id, c.nome
    ORDER BY 3 DESC LIMIT _limit;
  END IF;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_financial_inconsistencies()
 RETURNS TABLE(code text, severity text, entity_type text, entity_id uuid, description text, recommended_action text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'pg_catalog', 'public', 'pg_temp'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  PERFORM public.h15_require_staff();

  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado' USING ERRCODE='insufficient_privilege';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  -- 1. Entrega BILLED sem receivable_id
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_BILLED_NO_AR'::text, 'alta'::text, 'entregas'::text, e.id,
         'Entrega marcada como faturada sem título financeiro vinculado.'::text,
         'Reprocessar faturamento ou reverter status para PENDING_BILLING.'::text
    FROM public.entregas e
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'BILLED' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 2. Entrega NOT_BILLABLE com receivable_id
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_NOT_BILLABLE_WITH_AR', 'alta', 'entregas', e.id,
         'Entrega marcada como sem cobrança porém possui título financeiro.',
         'Revisar status financeiro da entrega ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.entregas e
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'NOT_BILLABLE' AND e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 3. Entrega com receivable_id apontando para AR inexistente
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_AR_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'entregas', e.id,
         'Entrega referencia um título que não existe mais.',
         'Limpar receivable_id ou recriar o título via faturamento.'
    FROM public.entregas e
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = e.receivable_id
   WHERE e.receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 4. AR sem parcelas
  SELECT 'AR_NO_INSTALLMENTS', 'alta', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Conta a receber sem parcelas geradas.',
         'Gerar parcelas manualmente ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
   WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
   GROUP BY ar.id
  HAVING count(ari.id) = 0

  UNION ALL
  -- 5. AP sem parcelas
  SELECT 'AP_NO_INSTALLMENTS', 'alta', 'accounts_payable', ap.id,
         'Conta a pagar sem parcelas geradas.',
         'Gerar parcelas manualmente ou cancelar o título.'
    FROM public.accounts_payable ap
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_payable_installments api ON api.payable_id = ap.id
   WHERE ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
   GROUP BY ap.id
  HAVING count(api.id) = 0

  UNION ALL
  -- 6. AR PAID com parcela ainda em aberto
  SELECT 'AR_PAID_OPEN_INSTALLMENT', 'critica', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Título marcado como PAGO mas possui parcela em aberto/parcial/vencida.',
         'Reprocessar status do título.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.status = 'PAID'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments ari
        WHERE ari.receivable_id = ar.id AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 7. AP PAID com parcela ainda em aberto
  SELECT 'AP_PAID_OPEN_INSTALLMENT', 'critica', 'accounts_payable', ap.id,
         'Título marcado como PAGO mas possui parcela em aberto/parcial/vencida.',
         'Reprocessar status do título.'
    FROM public.accounts_payable ap
   WHERE ap.status = 'PAID'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable_installments api
        WHERE api.payable_id = ap.id AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 8. Conta CANCELED com pagamento ativo (não estorno)
  SELECT 'AR_CANCELED_WITH_PAYMENT', 'alta', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Título cancelado possui baixas ativas não estornadas.',
         'Estornar pagamentos antes de manter o cancelamento.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.status = 'CANCELED'
     AND EXISTS (
       SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments ari
        JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.installment_id = ari.id
       WHERE ari.receivable_id = ar.id AND COALESCE(rp.is_reversal,false) = false
         AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments rp2 WHERE rp2.reversed_payment_id = rp.id)
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 9. Recibo emitido para pagamento de estorno
  SELECT 'RECEIPT_FOR_REVERSAL', 'alta', 'financial_receipts', fr.id,
         'Recibo emitido sobre um lançamento de estorno.',
         'Cancelar o recibo.'
    FROM public.financial_receipts fr
    JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.id = fr.payment_id
   WHERE fr.status = 'ISSUED' AND rp.is_reversal = true

  UNION ALL
  -- 10. Recibo emitido para pagamento inexistente
  SELECT 'RECEIPT_PAYMENT_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'financial_receipts', fr.id,
         'Recibo aponta para pagamento inexistente.',
         'Cancelar o recibo ou restaurar o pagamento.'
    FROM public.financial_receipts fr
    LEFT JOIN public.receivable_payments rp ON rp.id = fr.payment_id
   WHERE fr.status = 'ISSUED' AND fr.payment_id IS NOT NULL AND rp.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 11. NF vinculada a AR inexistente
  SELECT 'FISCAL_INVOICE_AR_BROKEN_FK', 'critica', 'fiscal_invoices', fi.id,
         'Nota fiscal vinculada a um título que não existe.',
         'Religar a NF a um título válido ou cancelá-la.'
    FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fi
    LEFT JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = fi.receivable_id
   WHERE fi.receivable_id IS NOT NULL AND ar.id IS NULL

  UNION ALL
  -- 12. Documento financeiro órfão (owner_id sem registro)
  SELECT 'FINANCIAL_DOC_ORPHAN', 'media', 'financial_documents', fd.id,
         'Documento financeiro vinculado a um registro inexistente ('||fd.owner_type||').',
         'Excluir logicamente ou religar a entidade correta.'
    FROM public.financial_documents fd
   WHERE fd.deleted_at IS NULL
     AND (
       (fd.owner_type = 'RECEIVABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'PAYABLE' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'FISCAL_INVOICE' AND public.h15_invoice_access(fd.owner_id) AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM (SELECT * FROM public.fiscal_invoices WHERE public.h15_company_access(company_settings_id)) fiscal_invoices WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type IN ('PAYMENT_RECEIVABLE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.receivable_payments WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type IN ('PAYMENT_PAYABLE') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.payable_payments WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
       OR (fd.owner_type = 'FINANCIAL_RECEIPT' AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.financial_receipts WHERE id = fd.owner_id))
     )

  UNION ALL
  -- 13. Entrega faturada duplicada (mesma entrega com >1 AR)
  SELECT 'DELIVERY_DUPLICATED_AR', 'critica', 'accounts_receivable', ar.id,
         'Mais de um título financeiro foi gerado para a mesma entrega.',
         'Cancelar os títulos extras.'
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
   WHERE ar.origin_type = 'DELIVERY'
     AND ar.origin_id IN (
       SELECT origin_id FROM public.accounts_receivable
        WHERE origin_type = 'DELIVERY' AND origin_id IS NOT NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'
        GROUP BY origin_id HAVING count(*) > 1
     )

  ORDER BY 2, 1, 4;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6_guard_title_snapshot()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NEW.total_amount IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.total_amount
     OR NEW.installment_count IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.installment_count
     OR NEW.origin_type IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin_type
     OR NEW.origin_id IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.origin_id
     OR NEW.issue_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.issue_date
     OR NEW.first_due_date IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.first_due_date
     OR NEW.created_by IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_by
     OR NEW.created_at IS DISTINCT FROM OLD.created_at THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Snapshot financeiro imutavel: valor, parcelas, origem e datas de emissao nao podem ser alterados.'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;

  IF TG_TABLE_NAME = 'accounts_receivable'
     AND (to_jsonb(NEW)->>'payment_method_id') IS DISTINCT FROM (to_jsonb(OLD)->>'payment_method_id') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Condicao/metodo do titulo e imutavel apos a criacao: use o metodo na baixa (receivable_payments).'
      USING ERRCODE='check_violation';
  END IF;

  RETURN NEW;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_h6c_entrega_ar_b2b_link()
 RETURNS trigger
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_po public.partner_orders%ROWTYPE;
  v_settings record;
BEGIN
  IF NEW.receivable_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.partner_order_id IS NULL
     OR NEW.receivable_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM OLD.receivable_id THEN
    RETURN NEW;
  END IF;

  SELECT * INTO v_po FROM public.partner_orders WHERE id = NEW.partner_order_id FOR UPDATE;
  IF NOT FOUND THEN RETURN NEW; END IF;

  -- 1) o recebível passa a pertencer ao parceiro (entra em saldo_em_aberto)
  UPDATE public.accounts_receivable
     SET partner_id = v_po.partner_id
   WHERE id = NEW.receivable_id AND partner_id IS DISTINCT FROM v_po.partner_id;

  -- 2) vínculo financeiro canônico (idempotente: unique em partner_order_id)
  SELECT * INTO v_settings FROM public.partner_financial_settings WHERE partner_id = v_po.partner_id;
  INSERT INTO public.partner_order_financial_links(
    partner_order_id, partner_id, receivable_id, financial_status, billing_trigger, created_by)
  VALUES (v_po.id, v_po.partner_id, NEW.receivable_id, 'gerado',
          COALESCE(v_settings.billing_trigger, 'entrega'), NEW.billing_generated_by)
  ON CONFLICT (partner_order_id) DO NOTHING;

  -- 3) pedido deixa de ser "comprometido não faturado"
  UPDATE public.partner_orders
     SET financial_status = 'gerado',
         receivable_generated = true,
         receivable_generated_at = COALESCE(receivable_generated_at, now()),
         receivable_generated_by = COALESCE(receivable_generated_by, NEW.billing_generated_by)
   WHERE id = v_po.id AND COALESCE(receivable_generated,false) = false;

  RETURN NEW;
END
$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.fn_mark_financial_overdue()
 RETURNS void
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_org uuid := platform_private.h15_actor_organization();
BEGIN
 IF auth.uid() IS NULL OR v_org IS NULL OR NOT COALESCE(public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()),false) THEN
  RAISE EXCEPTION 'FINANCIAL_SCOPE_DENIED' USING ERRCODE='42501';
 END IF;
 UPDATE public.accounts_receivable_installments i SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OPEN' AND i.due_date<(pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable p WHERE p.id=i.receivable_id AND p.organization_id=v_org);
 UPDATE public.accounts_payable_installments i SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OPEN' AND i.due_date<(pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable p WHERE p.id=i.payable_id AND p.organization_id=v_org);
 UPDATE public.accounts_receivable p SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE p.organization_id=v_org AND p.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL')
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id=p.id AND i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OVERDUE');
 UPDATE public.accounts_payable p SET status='OVERDUE'
 WHERE p.organization_id=v_org AND p.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL')
 AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM public.accounts_payable_installments i WHERE i.payable_id=p.id AND i.organization_id=v_org AND i.status='OVERDUE');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_alerts(p_reference_date date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(alert_type text, severity text, title text, description text, amount numeric, count integer, action_key text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  -- 1 entregas sem faturamento
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'DELIVERIES_PENDING_BILLING'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Entregas confirmadas sem faturamento'::text,
         'Existem entregas concluídas que ainda não geraram conta a receber.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'entregas-nao-faturadas'::text
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 2 recebimentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_RECEIVABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Recebimentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a receber em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'receber-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
   WHERE ari.due_date < p_reference_date AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 3 pagamentos vencidos
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'OVERDUE_PAYABLES'::text, 'CRITICAL'::text,
         'Pagamentos vencidos'::text,
         'Parcelas a pagar em atraso.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)),0)::numeric,
         COUNT(*)::int, 'pagar-vencidos'::text
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
   WHERE api.due_date < p_reference_date AND api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 4 NF-e pendente
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'PENDING_FISCAL_INVOICE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'NF-e pendente'::text,
         'Contas a receber aguardando emissão de NF-e.'::text,
         COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'nfe-pendente'::text
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 5 categorias sem DRE
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'UNCLASSIFIED_DRE'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Categorias sem classificação DRE'::text,
         'Algumas categorias usadas em títulos não têm grupo DRE definido.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'categorias-dre'::text
    FROM financial_categories fc
   WHERE fc.dre_group IS NULL
     AND (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable ar WHERE ar.category_id = fc.id)
       OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable ap WHERE ap.category_id = fc.id))
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 6 recorrências com falha
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_FAILED'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências com falha'::text,
         'Erros recentes na geração automática de títulos recorrentes.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= (p_reference_date - INTERVAL '30 days')
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 7 recorrências atrasadas
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'RECURRING_DUE'::text, 'HIGH'::text,
         'Recorrências atrasadas para geração'::text,
         'Modelos recorrentes ativos com geração pendente.'::text,
         0::numeric, COUNT(*)::int, 'recorrencias'::text
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true AND auto_generate = true
     AND next_generation_date IS NOT NULL AND next_generation_date < p_reference_date
  HAVING COUNT(*) > 0;

  -- 8 contas sem centro de custo
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT 'MISSING_COST_CENTER'::text, 'MEDIUM'::text,
         'Contas sem centro de custo'::text,
         'Títulos financeiros sem centro de custo associado.'::text,
         0::numeric,
         ((SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
        + (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED'))::int,
         'centros-custo'::text
   WHERE EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_receivable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED')
      OR EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM accounts_payable WHERE cost_center_id IS NULL AND status <> 'CANCELED');
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_cashflow(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_view_mode text DEFAULT 'PROJECTED'::text, p_group_by text DEFAULT 'DAY'::text)
 RETURNS TABLE(period_label text, period_start date, expected_inflows numeric, expected_outflows numeric, realized_inflows numeric, realized_outflows numeric, projected_balance numeric, realized_balance numeric, accumulated_projected_balance numeric, accumulated_realized_balance numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v_trunc text; v_fmt text;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_group_by IS NULL OR upper(p_group_by) NOT IN ('DAY','WEEK','MONTH') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Agrupamento invalido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  IF p_view_mode IS NULL OR upper(p_view_mode) NOT IN ('PROJECTED','REALIZED','COMPARATIVE') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Modo de visualizacao invalido.' USING ERRCODE='22023';
  END IF;
  v_trunc := CASE upper(p_group_by) WHEN 'WEEK' THEN 'week' WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 'month' ELSE 'day' END;
  v_fmt := CASE upper(p_group_by) WHEN 'MONTH' THEN 'MM/YYYY' WHEN 'WEEK' THEN '"Sem" IW/IYYY' ELSE 'DD/MM' END;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH proj_in AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, ari.due_date)::date b,
           SUM(CASE WHEN ari.status = 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,ari.original_amount + COALESCE(ari.interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(ari.penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0)) END) v
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY 1
  ), proj_out AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, api.due_date)::date b,
           SUM(CASE WHEN api.status = 'PAID' THEN 0 ELSE GREATEST(0,api.original_amount + COALESCE(api.interest_amount,0) + COALESCE(api.penalty_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0)) END) v
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
     WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY 1
  ), real_in AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, rp.payment_date)::date b, SUM(rp.amount_received) v
      FROM receivable_payments rp
     WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     GROUP BY 1
  ), real_out AS (
    SELECT date_trunc(v_trunc, pp.payment_date)::date b, SUM(pp.amount_paid) v
      FROM payable_payments pp
     WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     GROUP BY 1
  ), buckets AS (
    SELECT b FROM proj_in UNION SELECT b FROM proj_out
    UNION SELECT b FROM real_in UNION SELECT b FROM real_out
  ), combined AS (
    SELECT b.b AS bk,
           COALESCE(pi.v,0)::numeric ei, COALESCE(po.v,0)::numeric eo,
           COALESCE(ri.v,0)::numeric ri_v, COALESCE(ro.v,0)::numeric ro_v
      FROM buckets b
      LEFT JOIN proj_in pi ON pi.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN proj_out po ON po.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN real_in ri ON ri.b = b.b
      LEFT JOIN real_out ro ON ro.b = b.b
  )
  SELECT to_char(bk, v_fmt),
         bk,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='REALIZED' THEN 0 ELSE ei END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='REALIZED' THEN 0 ELSE eo END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='PROJECTED' THEN 0 ELSE ri_v END,
         CASE WHEN upper(p_view_mode)='PROJECTED' THEN 0 ELSE ro_v END,
         (ei - eo)::numeric,
         (ri_v - ro_v)::numeric,
         SUM(ei - eo) OVER (ORDER BY bk)::numeric,
         SUM(ri_v - ro_v) OVER (ORDER BY bk)::numeric
    FROM combined
   ORDER BY bk;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dashboard_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_category_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, p_customer_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  r jsonb;
  v_rec_expected numeric := 0; v_rec_received numeric := 0;
  v_rec_open numeric := 0; v_rec_overdue numeric := 0; v_rec_partial numeric := 0;
  v_rec_overdue_count int := 0; v_rec_avg_days int := 0;
  v_pay_expected numeric := 0; v_pay_paid numeric := 0;
  v_pay_open numeric := 0; v_pay_overdue numeric := 0; v_pay_partial numeric := 0;
  v_pay_overdue_count int := 0;
  v_nfe_count int := 0; v_nfe_amount numeric := 0;
  v_deliv_count int := 0; v_deliv_amount numeric := 0;
  v_rec_recurring numeric := 0; v_pay_recurring numeric := 0;
  v_rec_errors int := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  -- A receber (previsto: pelo vencimento no período)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int,
         COALESCE(AVG((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)
           FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0)::int
    INTO v_rec_expected, v_rec_open, v_rec_overdue, v_rec_partial, v_rec_overdue_count, v_rec_avg_days
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A receber (realizado: por payment_date)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0)
    INTO v_rec_received
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
   WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_customer_id IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = p_customer_id)
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ar.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (previsto)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(api.original_amount - COALESCE(api.paid_amount,0) - COALESCE(api.discount_amount,0))
           FILTER (WHERE api.status = 'PARTIAL'),0),
         COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE api.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND api.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date)::int
    INTO v_pay_expected, v_pay_open, v_pay_overdue, v_pay_partial, v_pay_overdue_count
    FROM accounts_payable_installments api
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- A pagar (realizado)
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0)
    INTO v_pay_paid
    FROM payable_payments pp
    JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
   WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
     AND (p_category_id IS NULL OR ap.category_id = p_category_id)
     AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id);

  -- NF-e pendente
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(total_amount),0)
    INTO v_nfe_count, v_nfe_amount
    FROM accounts_receivable
   WHERE fiscal_invoice_required = true
     AND fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING';

  -- Entregas pendentes faturamento
  SELECT COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(e.quantidade_entregue * COALESCE(p.valor_litro_brl,0)),0)
    INTO v_deliv_count, v_deliv_amount
    FROM entregas e LEFT JOIN produtos p ON p.id = e.produto_id
   WHERE e.financial_status = 'PENDING_BILLING' AND e.receivable_id IS NULL;

  -- Recorrências ativas
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='RECEIVABLE'),0),
         COALESCE(SUM(amount) FILTER (WHERE type='PAYABLE'),0)
    INTO v_rec_recurring, v_pay_recurring
    FROM recurring_financial_templates
   WHERE active = true;

  SELECT COUNT(*)::int INTO v_rec_errors
    FROM recurring_generation_log WHERE status = 'FAILED' AND generated_at >= ((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - INTERVAL '30 days');

  r := jsonb_build_object(
    'total_receivable_expected', v_rec_expected,
    'total_receivable_received', v_rec_received,
    'total_receivable_open', v_rec_open,
    'total_receivable_overdue', v_rec_overdue,
    'total_receivable_partial', v_rec_partial,
    'overdue_receivables_count', v_rec_overdue_count,
    'average_days_overdue', v_rec_avg_days,
    'total_payable_expected', v_pay_expected,
    'total_payable_paid', v_pay_paid,
    'total_payable_open', v_pay_open,
    'total_payable_overdue', v_pay_overdue,
    'total_payable_partial', v_pay_partial,
    'overdue_payables_count', v_pay_overdue_count,
    'projected_balance', v_rec_expected - v_pay_expected,
    'realized_balance', v_rec_received - v_pay_paid,
    'collection_rate', CASE WHEN v_rec_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_rec_received / v_rec_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'payment_rate', CASE WHEN v_pay_expected > 0 THEN ROUND((v_pay_paid / v_pay_expected)::numeric, 4) ELSE 0 END,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_count', v_nfe_count,
    'pending_fiscal_invoice_amount', v_nfe_amount,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_count', v_deliv_count,
    'pending_billing_deliveries_amount', v_deliv_amount,
    'active_recurring_receivables_amount', v_rec_recurring,
    'active_recurring_payables_amount', v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_net_balance', v_rec_recurring - v_pay_recurring,
    'recurring_generation_errors_count', v_rec_errors
  );
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_financial_dre_summary(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_regime text DEFAULT 'CASH'::text, p_cost_center_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb; g RECORD;
  v_groups jsonb := '{}'::jsonb;
  v_unclassified jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  v_receita numeric := 0; v_deducoes numeric := 0;
  v_resultado numeric := 0; v_margem numeric := 0;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='Período inválido';
  END IF;
  IF p_regime IS NULL OR upper(p_regime) NOT IN ('CASH','ACCRUAL') THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION USING ERRCODE='22023', MESSAGE='Regime inválido';
  END IF;

  IF upper(p_regime) = 'ACCRUAL' THEN
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(ari.original_amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS qtd
        FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
        JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
       WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp), jsonb_build_object('total', g.total, 'qtd', g.qtd)); END LOOP;
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(api.original_amount) AS total, COUNT(*) AS qtd
        FROM accounts_payable_installments api
        JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
       WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP
      v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp),
        COALESCE(v_groups->lower(g.grp),'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('total',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'total')::numeric,0) + g.total, 'qtd',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'qtd')::int,0) + g.qtd::int));
    END LOOP;
  ELSE
    -- CASH: NÃO filtrar is_reversal. O estorno tem valor negativo e cancela o pagamento original na soma.
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(rp.amount_received) AS total,
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(rp.is_reversal,false) = false) AS qtd
        FROM receivable_payments rp
        JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.id = rp.installment_id
        JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
       WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp), jsonb_build_object('total', g.total, 'qtd', g.qtd)); END LOOP;
    FOR g IN
      SELECT COALESCE(fc.dre_group,'SEM_CLASSIFICACAO') AS grp, SUM(pp.amount_paid) AS total,
             COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE COALESCE(pp.is_reversal,false) = false) AS qtd
        FROM payable_payments pp
        JOIN accounts_payable_installments api ON api.id = pp.installment_id
        JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
        LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
       WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date
         AND (p_cost_center_id IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = p_cost_center_id)
       GROUP BY 1
    LOOP
      v_groups := v_groups || jsonb_build_object(lower(g.grp),
        COALESCE(v_groups->lower(g.grp),'{}'::jsonb) || jsonb_build_object('total',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'total')::numeric,0) + g.total, 'qtd',
          COALESCE((v_groups->lower(g.grp)->>'qtd')::int,0) + g.qtd::int));
    END LOOP;
  END IF;

  SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', id, 'name', name))
    INTO v_unclassified
    FROM financial_categories WHERE dre_group IS NULL AND active = true;

  v_receita := COALESCE((v_groups->'receita_bruta'->>'total')::numeric,0)
             + COALESCE((v_groups->'outras_receitas'->>'total')::numeric,0);
  v_deducoes := COALESCE((v_groups->'deducoes'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'custo_producao'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_variavel'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_fixa'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_administrativa'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_comercial'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'despesa_financeira'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'impostos'->>'total')::numeric,0)
              + COALESCE((v_groups->'outras_despesas'->>'total')::numeric,0);
  v_resultado := v_receita - v_deducoes;
  v_margem := CASE WHEN v_receita > 0 THEN (v_resultado / v_receita) * 100 ELSE 0 END;

  r := v_groups
    || jsonb_build_object('resultado_operacional', v_resultado,
                          'margem_operacional_percentual', v_margem,
                          'unclassified_categories', COALESCE(v_unclassified, '[]'::jsonb));
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_customer_statement(_customer_id uuid, _from date, _to date)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;
  IF _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  WITH entregas_periodo AS (
    SELECT e.id, e.receivable_id
    FROM entregas e
    WHERE e.cliente_id = _customer_id
      AND e.status = 'entregue'::status_entrega
      AND COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ),
  delivered_links AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT ep.receivable_id
    FROM entregas_periodo ep
    WHERE ep.receivable_id IS NOT NULL
  ),
  delivered AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.total_amount),0) AS total
    FROM delivered_links dl
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = dl.receivable_id
    WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND ar.customer_id = _customer_id
  ),
  delivered_meta AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS total_deliveries,
           COUNT(*) FILTER (WHERE ep.receivable_id IS NULL) AS unlinked
    FROM entregas_periodo ep
  ),
  billed AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ar.total_amount),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    WHERE ar.customer_id = _customer_id
      AND ar.issue_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  ),
  pagamentos AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received) FILTER (WHERE rp.is_reversal = false),0) AS bruto,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0) AS liquido
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE ar.customer_id = _customer_id
      AND rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ),
  open_bal AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0)),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE ar.customer_id = _customer_id
      AND i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'customer_id', _customer_id,
    'period', jsonb_build_object('from', _from, 'to', _to),
    'delivered', (SELECT total FROM delivered),
    'delivered_basis', 'accounts_receivable_linked_to_confirmed_deliveries',
    'delivered_deliveries_count', (SELECT total_deliveries FROM delivered_meta),
    'delivered_unlinked_count', (SELECT unlinked FROM delivered_meta),
    'billed', (SELECT total FROM billed),
    'cash_basis', 'NET_OF_REVERSALS',
    'received', (SELECT liquido FROM pagamentos),
    'received_gross', (SELECT bruto FROM pagamentos),
    'received_net_of_reversals', (SELECT liquido FROM pagamentos),
    'open_balance', (SELECT total FROM open_bal)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_delinquency(_as_of date DEFAULT CURRENT_DATE)
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, customer_name text, description text, due_date date, amount numeric, balance numeric, days_overdue integer, customer_phone text, customer_email text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.id, COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'), ar.description, i.due_date, i.amount,
    i.amount - COALESCE((SELECT SUM(rp.amount_received) FROM receivable_payments rp
                         WHERE rp.installment_id = i.id AND rp.is_reversal=false),0),
    (_as_of - i.due_date)::int,
    COALESCE(c.contato_financeiro_telefone, c.telefone),
    COALESCE(c.contato_financeiro_email, c.email)
  FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
  JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.cliente_id
  WHERE i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND i.due_date < _as_of
  ORDER BY i.due_date;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_deliveries_billing_status(_from date, _to date)
 RETURNS TABLE(delivery_id uuid, customer_name text, delivery_date date, total_value numeric, billed boolean, receivable_id uuid)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL OR _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT e.id,
         COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'),
         COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida),
         COALESCE(ar.total_amount, 0)::numeric,
         (ar.id IS NOT NULL),
         ar.id
  FROM entregas e
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = e.cliente_id
  LEFT JOIN accounts_receivable ar
         ON ar.id = e.receivable_id
        AND ar.customer_id = e.cliente_id
        AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  WHERE COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) BETWEEN _from AND _to
  ORDER BY COALESCE(e.entregue_em::date, e.data_saida) DESC, e.id;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_monthly_financial(_from date, _to date, _cost_center uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid, _regime text DEFAULT 'CASH'::text)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;

  IF _from IS NULL OR _to IS NULL OR _to < _from THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Período inválido' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  WITH rec AS (
    -- regime caixa líquido: inclui linhas de estorno (amount_received negativo)
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0) AS total,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received) FILTER (WHERE rp.is_reversal = false),0) AS bruto
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  pag AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid),0) AS total,
           COALESCE(SUM(pp.amount_paid) FILTER (WHERE pp.is_reversal = false),0) AS bruto
    FROM payable_payments pp
    JOIN accounts_payable_installments i ON i.id = pp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
    WHERE pp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  prev_rec AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE i.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  prev_pag AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount),0) AS total
    FROM accounts_payable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
    WHERE i.due_date BETWEEN _from AND _to AND ap.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  overdue_rec AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0)),0) AS total,
      COUNT(*) AS qty
    FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    WHERE i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  overdue_pay AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS qty FROM accounts_payable_installments i
    JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = i.payable_id
    WHERE i.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND i.due_date < CURRENT_DATE
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ap.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
  ),
  nfe_pend AS (
    SELECT COUNT(*) AS qty FROM accounts_receivable ar
    WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED' AND (
      ar.fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
      OR (COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required,false)=true
          AND COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status,'PENDING') <> 'ISSUED'))
  ),
  by_cat AS (
    SELECT fc.name AS category,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received),0) AS received,
           COALESCE(SUM(rp.amount_received) FILTER (WHERE rp.is_reversal = false),0) AS received_gross
    FROM receivable_payments rp
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments i ON i.id = rp.installment_id
    JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
    LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
    WHERE rp.payment_date BETWEEN _from AND _to
      AND (_cost_center IS NULL OR ar.cost_center_id = _cost_center)
    GROUP BY fc.name
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'period', jsonb_build_object('from', _from, 'to', _to),
    'regime', _regime,
    'cash_basis', 'NET_OF_REVERSALS',
    'received', (SELECT total FROM rec),
    'received_gross', (SELECT bruto FROM rec),
    'paid', (SELECT total FROM pag),
    'paid_gross', (SELECT bruto FROM pag),
    'expected_receivable', (SELECT total FROM prev_rec),
    'expected_payable', (SELECT total FROM prev_pag),
    'net_cash', (SELECT total FROM rec) - (SELECT total FROM pag),
    'overdue_receivable_total', (SELECT total FROM overdue_rec),
    'overdue_receivable_count', (SELECT qty FROM overdue_rec),
    'overdue_payable_count', (SELECT qty FROM overdue_pay),
    'nfe_pending_count', (SELECT qty FROM nfe_pend),
    'by_category', COALESCE((SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'category',category,'received',received,'received_gross',received_gross)) FROM by_cat), '[]'::jsonb)
  ) INTO r;
  RETURN r;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_nfe_pending(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(receivable_id uuid, customer_name text, description text, total_amount numeric, issue_date date, fiscal_invoice_status text, fiscal_invoice_required boolean, origin_type text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT ar.id, COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'), ar.description,
         ar.total_amount, ar.issue_date,
         COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status, 'PENDING'),
         COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required, false),
         COALESCE(ar.origin_type, 'MANUAL')
  FROM accounts_receivable ar
  LEFT JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
  WHERE ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
    AND (ar.fiscal_invoice_status = 'PENDING'
         OR (COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_required,false)=true
             AND COALESCE(ar.fiscal_invoice_status,'PENDING') <> 'ISSUED'))
  ORDER BY ar.issue_date DESC NULLS LAST;
END$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_report_receivables(_filters jsonb DEFAULT '{}'::jsonb)
 RETURNS TABLE(installment_id uuid, receivable_id uuid, customer_name text, description text, category text, due_date date, amount numeric, paid numeric, balance numeric, status text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE _from date := (_filters->>'from')::date;
        _to date := (_filters->>'to')::date;
        _status text := _filters->>'status';
        _customer uuid := NULLIF(_filters->>'customer_id','')::uuid;
BEGIN
  IF NOT is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT i.id, ar.id, COALESCE(c.nome, c.razao_social, '—'), ar.description, fc.name,
         i.due_date, i.original_amount,
         COALESCE(i.received_amount,0),
         i.original_amount - COALESCE(i.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(i.discount_amount,0),
         i.status
  FROM accounts_receivable_installments i
  JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = i.receivable_id
  JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
  LEFT JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
  WHERE (_from IS NULL OR i.due_date >= _from)
    AND (_to IS NULL OR i.due_date <= _to)
    AND (_status IS NULL OR i.status = _status)
    AND (_customer IS NULL OR ar.customer_id = _customer)
    AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
  ORDER BY i.due_date;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.get_top_financial_rankings(p_start_date date, p_end_date date, p_limit integer DEFAULT 10)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE r jsonb; v_top_clientes jsonb; v_top_rec_cat jsonb; v_top_desp_cat jsonb; v_top_inad jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT public.is_financial_staff(auth.uid()) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Acesso negado'; END IF;
  IF p_start_date IS NULL OR p_end_date IS NULL OR p_start_date > p_end_date THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'Periodo invalido: informe datas inicial e final em ordem.' USING ERRCODE = '22023';
  END IF;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_clientes FROM (
    SELECT ar.customer_id, c.nome AS customer_name,
           SUM(ari.original_amount)::numeric AS total_revenue,
           COALESCE(SUM(ari.received_amount),0)::numeric AS received_amount,
           COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))
             FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')),0)::numeric AS open_amount
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY ar.customer_id, c.nome
     ORDER BY total_revenue DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_rec_cat FROM (
    SELECT fc.id AS category_id, fc.name AS category_name, SUM(ari.original_amount)::numeric AS total_amount
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ar.category_id
     WHERE ari.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND ari.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY fc.id, fc.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_desp_cat FROM (
    SELECT fc.id AS category_id, fc.name AS category_name, SUM(api.original_amount)::numeric AS total_amount
      FROM accounts_payable_installments api
      JOIN accounts_payable ap ON ap.id = api.payable_id
      JOIN financial_categories fc ON fc.id = ap.category_id
     WHERE api.due_date BETWEEN p_start_date AND p_end_date AND api.status <> 'CANCELED'
     GROUP BY fc.id, fc.name ORDER BY total_amount DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  SELECT COALESCE(jsonb_agg(t),'[]'::jsonb) INTO v_top_inad FROM (
    SELECT ar.customer_id, c.nome AS customer_name,
           SUM(ari.original_amount - COALESCE(ari.received_amount,0) - COALESCE(ari.discount_amount,0))::numeric AS overdue_amount,
           COUNT(*)::int AS overdue_count,
           MAX((pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date - ari.due_date)::int AS max_days_overdue
      FROM accounts_receivable_installments ari
      JOIN accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = ari.receivable_id
      JOIN clientes c ON c.id = ar.customer_id
     WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE') AND ari.due_date < (pg_catalog.now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Sao_Paulo')::date
     GROUP BY ar.customer_id, c.nome
     ORDER BY overdue_amount DESC LIMIT p_limit
  ) t;

  r := jsonb_build_object(
    'top_customers_revenue', v_top_clientes,
    'top_revenue_categories', v_top_rec_cat,
    'top_expense_categories', v_top_desp_cat,
    'top_overdue_customers', v_top_inad
  );
  RETURN r;
END $function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_aging(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(faixa text, qtd_titulos integer, valor numeric, parceiros integer)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  -- H7O: autorização explícita (antes: filtro h7n_guarded devolvia 0 linhas).
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: aging B2B restrito a administrador/gestor/financeiro/gestor_comercial/administrativo.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id, ari.id,
           (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
           GREATEST(0, (current_date - ari.due_date)) AS dias
    FROM public.accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN public.accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ar.status <> 'CANCELED'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ), faixas AS (
    SELECT CASE
             WHEN dias <= 30 THEN '0-30'
             WHEN dias <= 60 THEN '31-60'
             WHEN dias <= 90 THEN '61-90'
             ELSE '90+'
           END AS faixa, partner_id, saldo
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT faixa, COUNT(*)::int, COALESCE(SUM(saldo),0), COUNT(DISTINCT partner_id)::int
  FROM faixas GROUP BY faixa
  ORDER BY CASE faixa WHEN '0-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
END
$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(faixa text, qtd_titulos integer, valor numeric, qtd_parceiros integer, pct_carteira numeric, valor_medio_parceiro numeric)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_total numeric;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)

  END IF;
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id, ari.id AS inst_id,
      (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
      GREATEST(0, (CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)) AS dias_atraso
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR ar.issue_date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR ar.issue_date <= p_to)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR ari.status = p_status)
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS bucket
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT COALESCE(SUM(saldo),0) INTO v_total FROM classed;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH base AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id,
      (ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) AS saldo,
      GREATEST(0, (CURRENT_DATE - ari.due_date)) AS dias_atraso
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type = 'B2B_ORDER'
      AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR ar.issue_date >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR ar.issue_date <= p_to)
      AND (p_status IS NULL OR ari.status = p_status)
  ),
  classed AS (
    SELECT *,
      CASE
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 30 THEN '0-30'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 60 THEN '31-60'
        WHEN dias_atraso <= 90 THEN '61-90'
        ELSE '90+'
      END AS bucket
    FROM base
  )
  SELECT
    b AS faixa,
    COALESCE(COUNT(c.*),0)::int AS qtd_titulos,
    COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)::numeric AS valor,
    COALESCE(COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id),0)::int AS qtd_parceiros,
    CASE WHEN v_total > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)/v_total)*100,2) ELSE 0 END AS pct_carteira,
    CASE WHEN COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(SUM(c.saldo),0)/COUNT(DISTINCT c.partner_id),2) ELSE 0 END AS valor_medio_parceiro
  FROM (VALUES ('0-30'),('31-60'),('61-90'),('90+')) AS f(b)
  LEFT JOIN classed c ON c.bucket = f.b
  GROUP BY f.b
  ORDER BY CASE f.b WHEN '0-30' THEN 1 WHEN '31-60' THEN 2 WHEN '61-90' THEN 3 ELSE 4 END;
END;$function$

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_partner_profitability(p_from date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_to date DEFAULT NULL::date, p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS TABLE(partner_id uuid, partner_name text, total_comprado numeric, total_recebido numeric, total_aberto numeric, ticket_medio numeric, qtd_pedidos integer, prazo_medio_pgto numeric, inadimplencia_pct numeric, risk_score integer, risk_level text)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
#variable_conflict use_column
BEGIN
  -- H7O: autorização explícita (antes: filtro h7n_guarded devolvia 0 linhas).
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
       OR public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501',
      HINT = 'H7O: rentabilidade B2B restrita a administrador/gestor/financeiro/gestor_comercial/administrativo.';
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  WITH pedidos AS (
    SELECT po.partner_id, COUNT(*) AS qtd, SUM(po.total) AS total
    FROM partner_orders po
    WHERE po.status NOT IN ('cancelado','reprovado','rascunho')
      AND (p_from IS NULL OR po.created_at >= p_from)
      AND (p_to   IS NULL OR po.created_at <= (p_to + 1))
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR po.partner_id = p_partner_id)
    GROUP BY po.partner_id
  ),
  recebidos AS (
    SELECT ar.partner_id,
      SUM(ari.received_amount) AS rec,
      SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) FILTER (WHERE ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')) AS aberto,
      AVG(CASE WHEN ari.paid_at IS NOT NULL THEN EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM (ari.paid_at - ar.issue_date))/86400 END) AS prazo_med,
      SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount) FILTER (WHERE ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')) AS vencido
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER'

    COALESCE(r.rec,0),

    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.qtd,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(p.total/p.qtd,2) ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(p.qtd,0)::int,
    ROUND(COALESCE(r.prazo_med,0)::numeric,2),
    CASE WHEN COALESCE(p.total,0) > 0 THEN ROUND((COALESCE(r.vencido,0)/p.total)*100,2) ELSE 0 END,
    COALESCE(prs.score,0),
    COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')
  FROM partner_accounts pa
  LEFT JOIN pedidos p ON p.partner_id = pa.id
  LEFT JOIN recebidos r ON r.partner_id = pa.id
  LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = pa.id
  WHERE pa.ativo = true AND pa.deleted_at IS NULL
    AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR pa.id = p_partner_id)
    AND (p.qtd IS NOT NULL OR r.rec IS NOT NULL)
  ORDER BY COALESCE(p.total,0) DESC;
END

CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION public.rpc_b2b_revenue_forecast(p_partner_id uuid DEFAULT NULL::uuid)
 RETURNS jsonb
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE v jsonb;
BEGIN
  IF NOT (public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrador'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'financeiro'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'gestor_comercial'::public.app_role)
      or public.has_role(auth.uid(), 'administrativo'::public.app_role)) THEN
    RAISE EXCEPTION 'permission_denied' USING ERRCODE = '42501';
  END IF;
  WITH conf AS (
    SELECT
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 30 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c30,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 60 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c60,
      SUM(CASE WHEN ari.due_date <= CURRENT_DATE + 90 THEN ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount ELSE 0 END) AS c90
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  proj AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(total),0) AS p30
    FROM partner_orders WHERE receivable_generated = false
      AND status IN ('aprovado','em_producao','produzido','aguardando_entrega','em_separacao','enviado','entregue')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR partner_id = p_partner_id)
  ),
  risk AS (
    SELECT COALESCE(SUM(ari.original_amount - ari.received_amount),0) AS r
    FROM accounts_receivable ar
    JOIN accounts_receivable_installments ari ON ari.receivable_id = ar.id
    LEFT JOIN partner_risk_scores prs ON prs.partner_id = ar.partner_id
    WHERE ar.origin_type='B2B_ORDER' AND ari.status IN ('OPEN','PARTIAL','OVERDUE')
      AND (ari.due_date < CURRENT_DATE OR COALESCE(prs.risk_level,'baixo')='critico')
      AND (p_partner_id IS NULL OR ar.partner_id = p_partner_id)
  )
  SELECT jsonb_build_object(
    'confirmada_30', COALESCE((SELECT c30 FROM conf),0),
    'confirmada_60', COALESCE((SELECT c60 FROM conf),0),
    'confirmada_90', COALESCE((SELECT c90 FROM conf),0),
    'projetada', COALESCE((SELECT p30 FROM proj),0),
    'em_risco', COALESCE((SELECT r FROM risk),0)
  ) INTO v;
  RETURN v;
END;$function$

 RETURNS TABLE(partner_order_id uuid, numero text, receivable_id uuid, total numeric, vencimento date, financial_status text, payment_method text, ar_status text, installments jsonb)
 LANGUAGE plpgsql
 STABLE SECURITY DEFINER
 SET search_path TO 'public'
AS $function$
DECLARE
  v_uid uuid := auth.uid();
  v_is_staff boolean := (has_role(v_uid, 'administrador'::app_role) OR has_role(v_uid, 'gestor_comercial'::app_role));
  v_filter_partner uuid;
BEGIN
  IF p_partner_id IS NOT NULL THEN
    IF NOT v_is_staff THEN
      -- Parceiro só pode ver o próprio; ignora tentativa de simular
      v_filter_partner := NULL;
    ELSE
      v_filter_partner := p_partner_id;
    END IF;
  END IF;

  RETURN QUERY
  SELECT
    po.id, po.numero, ar.id, po.total, po.payment_due_date, po.financial_status, po.payment_method, ar.status,
    COALESCE((
      SELECT jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'numero', i.installment_number, 'vencimento', i.due_date,
        'valor', i.original_amount, 'recebido', i.received_amount, 'status', i.status
      ) ORDER BY i.installment_number)
      FROM public.accounts_receivable_installments i WHERE i.receivable_id = ar.id
    ), '[]'::jsonb)
  FROM public.partner_orders po
  JOIN public.partner_order_financial_links l ON l.partner_order_id = po.id
  JOIN public.accounts_receivable ar ON ar.id = l.receivable_id
  WHERE
    (
      v_filter_partner IS NOT NULL AND po.partner_id = v_filter_partner
    )
    OR (
      v_filter_partner IS NULL AND po.partner_id IN (SELECT partner_id FROM public.partner_users WHERE user_id = v_uid)
    )
  ORDER BY po.created_at DESC;
END $function$
